items.name: Rhein-Neckar Mental Breakdown 2023
items.information: Are you ready to showcase your lightning-fast problem-solving skills and mind-boggling memorization techniques? Join us for a thrilling day of cubing mastery as we dive into the world of Fewest Moves and Blindfolded events. Whether you're a seasoned cuber or new to the game, this competition promises excitement, challenge, and a chance to test your limits.

items.name: NxN Minnesota 2023
items.information:
This competition is a series competition with [Side Events Minnesota 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SideEventsMinnesota2023). ***You may only compete in one of these competitions.*** [Please click here for more info about series competitions.](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NxNMinnesota2023#32531-series-competitions-faq)

This competition is supported by the [Midwest Cubing Association (MCA)](https://www.midwestcubing.org/).
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcDAwIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--9d340df17a1aec4ba42677c10d4db2f31757ffba/image.png)

We have local Facebook groups for our Cubing Area. Feel free to join the [Minnesota Cubing Community](https://www.facebook.com/groups/1798123093777480) and follow the [Midwest Cubing Assocation](https://www.facebook.com/midwestcubing) for information and announcements on upcoming competitions.

items.information:

##### The [Venue Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/5x5onMadisonIce2023#34331-venue-travel-information) tab contains important Parking, Travel, and Accommodation information for before the competition.
